provisional_direction: Open suspected incident; do not label confirmed compromise
Offer out-of-band verification; avoid blame and isolate the suspect message
rationale: Employee reporting is evidence but no credential theft proven
reversal_or_review_trigger: Evidence of link use or credential entry

provisional_direction: Request support-app logs; confirm permissions and asset sensitivity
rationale: 41 reads could be normal bulk work or unauthorized access

provisional_direction: Propose SEV-2 and convene incident commander; reassess if impact changes
rationale: Potential customer data and sensitive vendor identity
reversal_or_review_trigger: Material impact/disclosure is confirmed or ruled out

provisional_direction: Propose suspend account, invalidate sessions and revoke tokens under change authority
rationale: Likely risk of repeat access; preserve safe service fallback
reversal_or_review_trigger: Verified false positive or controlled fallback approval

provisional_direction: Escalate collection, time sync, retention and provenance; mark exfiltration unknown
rationale: No authoritative export logs or real forensic chain
reversal_or_review_trigger: Corroborated ticket export logs and provenance

provisional_direction: Ask privacy/legal to assess exposure and obligations independently
rationale: Unverified personal data scope and rights risk
reversal_or_review_trigger: Verified personal-data content and recipient exposure

provisional_direction: Do not restore before token/session checks and reduced access; keep actions open
rationale: No verified invalidation test or independent signoff
reversal_or_review_trigger: Witnessed session invalidation and owner-approved recovery
